text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B in several installments let me realize gains while keeping some exposure; I should avoid letting the pleasure of locking in profits dictate every sale.","My account fell in periods 4 and 5 despite a profitable Stock C trade, reminding me to judge decisions by the whole portfolio and not one trade’s gain.","I should keep checking that each trade fits my risk and diversification plan, rather than reacting to short-term price moves or the discomfort of losses."]}
